# Regulation (EU) 2024/3234 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 19 December 2024

amending Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 as regards provisions relating to the date of application. Article 38 is amended so that Articles 3 to 13 apply from 30 December 2025, and from 30 June 2026 for operators or traders that by 31 December 2020 were established as micro-undertakings or small undertakings.
